verdict.rationale: First-party deployment docs explicitly cover setting up Unleash Open Source or Unleash Enterprise in your own environment with Docker. The GitHub repo presents the hosted instance as an alternative to running it yourself, and Edge can serve as a self-run read replica in front of your instance. Missing for 10: deployment-requirement detail (database, Kubernetes/Helm, upgrades) beyond a one-line docs snippet, and independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosting.
